create_interface_config: create an InterfaceConfig to generate solvent adsorbate slab and ion configurations for molecular simulations
create_interface_on_sites: build solvent and ion interface configurations on top of existing adsorbate slab atoms objects
create_packmol_atoms: pack solvent molecules and ions into a unit cell volume using packmol for molecular placement
run_packmol: run packmol with an input file to pack molecules into a specified geometry and output PDB
randomize_coords: randomly place atoms within their unit cell by computing weighted fractional coordinates
